Title: LSJ: Enrage,a nd how to burn it

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
Hi,

regarding the new SoC action, Enrage, this uncertainty came up:

In the PRE version, does "...this vampire's action" in the last
sentence refer only to an action for which the affected minion had to
burn 2 blood, or is any action (including hunting and entering combat)
eligible to burn the card?

Regards,

Hardy Range

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Any action this vampire takes is "this vampire's action".
